arguments.text: 6000 m, out-and-back legs of 1250 m (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000 m; last 1000 m is leg 5 out). Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) check instruments: pod vs heart rate vs GPS (pod drift, strap, GPS faults); out-and-back leg pairs cancel current, so compare legs() and measure() share each pair. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg -> clear_rudder (pacer also does). (3) check critical power from heart rate (levels off below CP, climbs above). (4) radio/course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (5) finish: pacer pushes only if pod reserve >40% under 800 m; if reserve is 10-40% near ~1000 m to go, spend it with a piece (+effort) timed to empty at the line. Save cues (20 max).

arguments.name: push_local_drop
arguments.description: push_local mean of the 2 min before the last 20 s minus the last 20 s (positive = local push fell, e.g. weed); only meaningful within a leg

arguments.name: pod_vs_hr
arguments.source:
p = window("shaft_power_w", 240)
h = window("heart_rate_bpm", 240)
(mean(p[180:]) / mean(p[:60])) - (mean(h[180:]) / mean(h[:60]))
arguments.description: relative change of pod power minus relative change of heart rate over 4 min (last 60 s vs first 60 s): large magnitude suggests pod or strap reading drift

arguments.text: 4 min (810 m): hard start drained pod reserve to 28%; pacer eased at 110 s. Now shaft 176 W ~ pod CP 172, HR 173-175 levelling. Leg 1 (north) local push +0.12-0.16 m/s, push_along +0.09. Watches: local_push_drop, pod_hr_diverge, sensor_sanity.

arguments.text: Ease slightly for two minutes, then back to pace.

5.7 min: paddler says cooked, 10/10, hurting. Pod reserve 25%, shaft ~174 W = pod CP 172. HR flat 172-175 since 126 s even though power fell 260->172 at 120-150 s (ceiling? or depletion term). HR moves ~0.4 bpm/W with small power changes, so not hard-pinned. Test: piece -6% for 120 s from 345 s (test_cost ~0 s). If HR drops ~4 bpm -> not at ceiling, paddler likely pessimistic; if flat -> suspect reserve near empty / CP low.

arguments.reason: cue gate was closed (pacer cued at 336 s): now send the -6% 120 s ease test piece unless something changed

arguments.text: 6.8 min: ease test piece NOT sent (gate closed, then the turn at ~380 s gave a natural test): shaft 180->157 W over the turn, HR 176->169. HR responds to power, so not at its ceiling: reserve not empty, pod CP ~right; paddler likely pessimistic. Check at ~470 s whether shaft power returned to ~174 after the turn; if still low the paddler is easing on their own -> reassure.

arguments.reason: did shaft power recover to ~174 W after the turn, or is the cooked paddler easing on their own (then reassure)?

arguments.text: Heart rate is steady, you are on pace. Long and smooth.

arguments.name: paddler_self_report
arguments.evidence: said cooked 10/10 at 341 s with pod reserve 25% at CP; HR dropped 176->169->166 when power dipped at the turn, so HR not at ceiling and reserve not empty

arguments.text: 7.8 min: post-turn shaft ~166 W (pacer ease at 336 s taking effect), HR 166, pod reserve refilling to 30%. Reassured at 471 s. ODD: push_local +0.12 on BOTH leg 1 (north) and leg 2 (south) although current should flip -> maybe the share estimate (eta_est) or pod gain is off, not current. After leg 2: measure leg1 (160-370 s) vs leg2 steady stretch, both directions, to split share vs push.
